# goslop text fixture — ImportError pass whose try block executes a call after
# the import; the fallback is not a pure optional-import guard (httpmorph
# benchmarks/benchmark.py:56 TP shape)
lang: python
file: function_import_pass.py
---
def connect():
    try:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv

        if Path(".env").exists():
            load_dotenv(".env")
    except ImportError:
        pass
    return None
